about: The IT Department's fax line (docs/story/STORY.md, "The IT Department's fax"). Replies: the first rule with one of its words in the email wins, so the specific ones come first. A Fax Machine on a battery's circuit prints the pages in order, the first within the hour, the rest while it stays plugged in. A Computer on a circuit emails IT whatever a player stands at it and types in chat; the answer comes back by fax. Lines: printable ASCII, at most 96 characters.

lines: TO: Unknown device on our network. FROM: IT Service Desk.
We have detected a fax machine that is not on the asset register.
Do not unplug it. Find a Computer and email us. Ticket #0001 has been opened.
REMINDER: Ticket #0001 is still open. If you have emailed us, your email is in a queue.
If you are reading this, you have power. Please confirm in writing, from a Computer.
NOTICE: Unlicensed scavenging of company hardware has been reported in your area.
Server racks, switches and dishes remain the property of the IT Department.
Return them, or fill in form IT-7 (Request To Keep Things).
MEMO: The IT Department is relocating. Our convoys are on the roads.
They carry spares. They also carry the Reply All. Please do not approach without a ticket.
SURVEY: How would you rate your experience with the IT Department today?
1 - Terrible  2 - Bad  3 - Fine  4 - Good  5 - We are watching. Email your answer.
TO: Valued user. Your ticket has been escalated to a senior technician.
He has a van. Expect him. Have you tried turning it off and on again?
RE: password. We never ask for your password. What is your password?
It must be 14 characters, one capital, one number, and not your previous 40 passwords.
RE: restart. Excellent. That fixes 92 percent of issues. Ticket closed.
To reopen it, open a new ticket.
RE: who we are. We are the IT Department. We kept the lights on when nobody else did.
The servers still run. Somebody has to patch them. Where do you think the power comes from?
RE: return of hardware. Form IT-7 received. Your request to keep things is under review.
Review takes six to eight weeks. In the meantime, the hardware is on loan. Do not drop it.
RE: procurement. All purchases go through procurement. Procurement is a fax machine.
You are talking to it. Bring circuit boards. We will think about it.
RE: threats. Threatening IT staff is a breach of the acceptable use policy.
Your account has been flagged. The Reply All is fuelled and on its way. Have a nice day.
RE: your request for help. Have you tried turning it off and on again?
If that does not work, please wait. Your place in the queue is 4,812.
RE: survey. Thank you for your feedback. It has been filed with the rest.
Your satisfaction is important to us. Please hold.
RE: your email. Hello. Your message has been received and logged.
Please state the nature of your problem in one line. Thank you for contacting IT.
RE: your email. Thank you for contacting the IT Service Desk.
Your ticket has been logged and will be ignored in the order it was received.
SECURITY ALERT: A device on your network clicked an advert. We know. We always know.
Malware is now running on your Computer. Do not give it your battery's code.
To remove it: have you tried turning it off and on again? Unplug it from the battery.

sent: Email sent to the IT Service Desk. Replies come by fax.
noFax: Email sent. IT replies by fax, and no fax is plugged in near this computer.
